mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS decline are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% over the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.5), or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in monthly employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the prior month signals a deteriorating labor market, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior two months signals an impending slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST decline >1% in 2 months) during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC for the signal in late-cycle is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior two months signals weakening economic activity, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO decline signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the core CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% year-over-year over the prior month signals persistent inflation, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL rise >0.5% in 1 month), or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior two months signals a broad-based demand slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both decline, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in quarterly real GDP (GDPC1) over the prior quarter signals a recessionary risk, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 declines, or the Rank IC for the GDPC1 decline signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
